data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Experience menu, then Baggage allowance, then select the cabin class) with cabin class as the parameter. The extra "open home page" and "read table" steps are harmless. It's slightly less concrete on exact selectors and on whether the options are tabs or links, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
